name: Ln882H Ble Tracker → On Ble Manufacturer Data Advertise
description:
An automation to perform when a BLE advertising packet with matching manufacturer data is received. See [`on_ble_manufacturer_data_advertise` Trigger](https://esphome.io/components/ln882h_ble_tracker/#ln882h_ble_tracker-on_ble_manufacturer_data_advertise).

This automation will be triggered when a BLE advertising packet with manufacturer-specific data is received. A variable `x` of type `std::vector<uint8_t>` is passed to the automation for use in lambdas.

config_entries.label: Manufacturer ID
config_entries.description: 16-bit, 32-bit, or 128-bit BLE manufacturer ID in hex.

config_entries.label: MAC Address
config_entries.description: The MAC address to filter for this automation.
